findings.summary: Design evidence lacks independent expected-result-source classification and seam-observation attestation, so a tautological or source-inspection script can manufacture RED/GREEN.
Public CLI detects drift before recordTddGreen and writes state only on success, leaving the persisted slice implementing instead of requiring fresh test design.
Public fixtures do not execute distinct asymmetric, tautological, source-inspection, timing, runtime-reuse, re-entry, and inapplicable known-bad adapters with invariant-specific failures.
Rename feat/spec-driven-tdd-gate to an allowed CONTRIBUTING.md prefix before delivery.
core.mjs accumulates several TDD change axes; defer extraction because it is a judgment-call refactor outside the narrow remediation and would expand risk.
